question: Please provide a list of the top three revenue-generating films for each actor, along with the average revenue per actor in those films, calculated by dividing the total film revenue equally among the actors for each film.
sql:
-- Final query
WITH film_revenue AS (
  SELECT 
    i.film_id,
    SUM(p.amount) as total_revenue
  FROM inventory i
  JOIN rental r ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id
  JOIN payment p ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id
  GROUP BY i.film_id
),
film_actor_count AS (
  SELECT film_id, COUNT(*) as num_actors
  FROM film_actor
  GROUP BY film_id
),
actor_film_revenue AS (
  SELECT 
    fa.actor_id,
    fr.film_id,
    fr.total_revenue / fac.num_actors as actor_revenue_share
  FROM film_actor fa
  JOIN film_revenue fr ON fa.film_id = fr.film_id
  JOIN film_actor_count fac ON fa.film_id = fac.film_id
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    actor_id,
    film_id,
    actor_revenue_share,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY actor_id ORDER BY actor_revenue_share DESC) as rn
  FROM actor_film_revenue
),
top3 AS (
  SELECT actor_id, film_id, actor_revenue_share, rn
  FROM ranked
  WHERE rn <= 3
)
SELECT 
  a.first_name,
  a.last_name,
  f.title,
  ROUND(t3.actor_revenue_share, 2) as revenue_per_actor,
  ROUND(AVG(t3.actor_revenue_share) OVER (PARTITION BY t3.actor_id), 2) as avg_revenue_per_actor
FROM top3 t3
JOIN actor a ON t3.actor_id = a.actor_id
JOIN film f ON t3.film_id = f.film_id
ORDER BY a.actor_id, t3.rn
